title: RAW-Explainer: Post-hoc Explanations of Path Reasoning Graph Neural Networks for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract: arXiv:2506.12558v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Path reasoning graph neural networks have demonstrated state-of-the-art performance on knowledge graph completion tasks such as link prediction. However, interpreting their predictions remains a challenging open problem, as most GNN explainability methods target node-level or graph-level tasks. In this paper, we propose RAW-Explainer ($\underline{Ra}$ndom $\underline{W}$alk Explainer), a novel explainability method tailored to path reasoning GNNs that generates connected, concise, and interpretable subgraph explanations for link prediction in knowledge graphs. Our method uses heterogeneous information to identify factual explanations and encourages connectivity through a random walk objective, using a parameterized model for efficient collective explanation. translated_title: RAW-Explainer：面向知识图谱补全的路径推理图神经网络事后解释方法
translated_abstract: 路径推理图神经网络在链接预测等知识图谱补全任务上已展现出最先进的性能。然而，解释其预测结果仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放性问题，因为大多数GNN可解释性方法针对的是节点级或图级任务。在本文中，我们提出了RAW-Explainer（随机游走解释器），这是一种专为路径推理GNN量身定制的新型可解释性方法，能够为知识图谱中的链接预测生成连通、简洁且可解释的子图解释。我们的方法利用异构信息来识别事实性解释，并通过随机游走目标函数来增强连通性，同时使用参数化模型实现高效的集体解释。此外，RAW-Explainer通过提出一种稳健的评估策略，克服了在评估比完整图小数个数量级的解释子图时出现的分布偏移问题。
tldr: 本文提出RAW-Explainer，一种专为路径推理图神经网络设计的新型可解释性方法，通过随机游走目标函数和异构信息，为知识图谱链接预测生成连通、简洁且可解释的子图解释，并解决了评估小子图时的分布偏移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RAW-Explainer, a novel explainability method tailored to path reasoning GNNs that generates connected, concise, and interpretable subgraph explanations for knowledge graph link prediction via a random walk objective and heterogeneous information, while addressing the distribution shift issue in evaluating small explanatory subgraphs.
